metadata.methodology: Closed-loop HTTP/1.1 keep-alive; direct and proxy blocks alternate order. Median difference is an estimate, not a per-request overhead distribution. Streaming first content excludes non-content SSE events.

aggregation: Nearest-rank quantiles of successful samples pooled across all three repeats, grouped by scenario, concurrency and target. Throughput uses combined successful count / combined measured duration. Individual samples omitted from this committed snapshot.

environment.backend: production web process, default info logging, no trace exporter
environment.network: Client, mock and backend use local loopback; PostgreSQL through Docker published port
environment.scope: Fresh disposable database; synthetic provider-key passthrough, no configured policy rules or virtual-key validation; tool definitions without tool calls; no inference provider requests
environment.sourceNote: Backend unchanged from metadata.gitCommit. Harness developed in this PR; later changes to failure handling do not affect this all-successful run.
